$comment: Fact ledger: every phone number, dollar figure, deadline and program-status claim this skill makes, with the primary source it was checked against. scripts/check-facts.mjs fails CI when a fact is past its recheck date (verified_on + recheck_days, or the explicit recheck_on), when a listed file is missing, or when the value (or each string in match) no longer appears in its files. Recheck intervals: phone numbers 180 days; dollar figures and program status 90; annual-cycle figures use recheck_on with the next cycle's date. To update a fact, re-verify it on the source, set verified_on to that day and, if the wording changed, update value/match. Never add a fact you have not verified yourself, and never back-date verified_on.

facts.claim: Missouri Secretary of State name reservation (60 days) costs $25
A foreign corporation's certificate of authority to do business in Missouri costs $155
Delaware corporation franchise tax: minimum $175 (Authorized Shares method) or $400 (Assumed Par Value Capital method), plus a $50 annual report fee, due March 1 each year
Section 1202 per-issuer exclusion: $15,000,000 for stock acquired after July 4, 2025 (P.L. 119-21 enactment); $10,000,000 for earlier stock; the $15M figure is indexed for tax years after 2026

Section 1202 exclusion by holding period: stock acquired after July 4, 2025 gets 50% at 3 years, 75% at 4 years, 100% at 5 years or more (26 USC 1202(a)(1)(B), (a)(5)); stock acquired on or before that date needs more than 5 years (100% if acquired after September 27, 2010, (a)(4))
facts.value: 50% of the gain at 3 years, 75% at 4 years, 100% at 5 years or more
match: 50% of the gain at 3 years, 75% at 4 years, 100% at 5 years or more

facts.claim: The Form 1099 information-return threshold is $2,000 for payments made after December 31, 2025 ($600 before), indexed for inflation for calendar years after 2026 (26 USC 6041(a), (h), as amended by P.L. 119-21 §70433)
Arch Grants Startup Competition: $75,000 equity-free grants plus $25,000 for companies relocating to St. Louis (2026 cycle closed March 31; 2027 reminder form open)
988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: call or text 988, free and confidential
